parent.reason: R47S forbids false depth amplification by disjoint independent copies

definition.d_F: minimum k>=0 such that some canonical ordered sequence of k exact-DP layers, each followed by the frozen certified normalization closure, ends in an independently verified terminal or canonical CLV strictly below the macro input; infinity if no such finite sequence exists
definition.reachable_domain: genuine residual fixpoints reached from canonical 3-CNF through the frozen pre-macro stack

A_SERIAL_AMPLIFICATION.target: construct a polynomial-size reachable family F_k with a proved lower bound d(F_k)>=k
requirements: canonical 3-CNF source and reachability receipt for every family member
coupled serial structure rather than disjoint independent copies
for every ordered DP sequence sigma with |sigma|<k, independent replay proves no terminal and no final CLV descent
no hidden SAT oracle, truth labels, advice, or nonuniform family-specific selector
no bypass pivot or alternate order that unlocks a later stage early
A_SERIAL_AMPLIFICATION.consequence_if_proved: refutes the universal fixed-constant-K route for this frozen grammar only; does not by itself prove superpolynomial complexity or P!=NP

B_STRUCTURAL_COLLAPSE.target: prove an absolute integer K independent of input size such that d(F)<=K for every reachable genuine residual fixpoint
requirements: symbolic proof over all reachable residuals, not finite testing
polynomial deterministic discovery of a certified sequence of length <=K
fixed polynomial bound on all intermediate DP representations and normalization certificates
independent compositional replay of every accepted sequence
B_STRUCTURAL_COLLAPSE.consequence_if_proved: closes the fixed-depth resource form of O4 when composed with already sealed O2/O3/O5 obligations, subject to correctness/reachability assumptions remaining pinned

C_UNBOUNDED_BUT_COMPRESSED.target: if d(F) is unbounded, exhibit a polynomial representation/discovery method that avoids explicit V^k sequence enumeration and repeated C->C^2 expansion
requirements: no implicit exponential search hidden in compression or reconstruction
C_UNBOUNDED_BUT_COMPRESSED.consequence_if_proved: unbounded raw depth would not automatically defeat polynomial O4; a separate compressed polynomial route could remain viable

first_symbolic_obligations: define an unlocking relation U_F(v,w): eliminating v plus closure changes the certified fate of pivot w from nonaccepted to accepted or lowers its debt
separate local unlocking from global bypass resistance
prove a serial lower-bound lemma requiring ordered causal dependence between stages
or prove an unlocking-diameter collapse lemma bounding the causal chain length by a universal constant
relate any chain bound to reachable residual invariants rather than arbitrary CNF structure

success_conditions.AMPLIFICATION_THEOREM: reachable polynomial-size family with rigorously proved unbounded lower bounds on d(F)
success_conditions.COLLAPSE_THEOREM: one fixed K with universal symbolic coverage and polynomial discovery/certificates
success_conditions.COMPRESSED_ROUTE_THEOREM: unbounded-depth route represented, discovered, and verified within an explicit polynomial envelope
success_conditions.EXPLICIT_FINITE_COUNTEREXAMPLE: records only the corresponding finite lower bound and updates K lower bound; no theorem elevation
